payload.core_mechanism_summary: Maintain dp[j] = number of good subsequences of length j, iterating array and for each a_i, update dp[j] += dp[j-1] for all divisors j of a_i.
payload.rationale: The DP state is a one-dimensional array indexed by subsequence length, updated over elements using descending divisors to avoid overcounting. No multi-dimensional state needed.
